creator: Alexander Terp
description: From review of 0b4d99ad (2026-11-11). A daemon handoff forgets that the person was told of a helper's block and restarts its 30 minutes, so a block that outlasts a handoff earns a second notice 30 minutes after it. The fix is a field beside maker_told in proto/muster_daemon.proto's handoff message. Marking every carried block as told was rejected: it turns a rare duplicate into a missed notice.
title: Carry through a handoff when a helper's block began and whether the person was told
